# Buy Pallet Jacks

> Buy Pallet Jacks sells professionally refurbished and inspected manual pallet jacks (Crown and Altra models) across 32 pickup locations nationwide in the United States. Every unit includes a 2-month warranty, same-day pickup availability, and pricing 40% to 60% below new retail prices. Multi-unit volume discounts and nationwide freight delivery are available.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.buypalletjacks.com/): Overview of refurbished pallet jacks, pricing, warranty coverage, customer reviews, and immediate order options.
- [All Locations Directory](https://www.buypalletjacks.com/locations): Interactive directory of all 32 warehouse and self-storage pickup facilities across the USA.
- [Bulk Pallet Jacks](https://www.buypalletjacks.com/bulk-pallet-jacks): Information for commercial warehouses and fleet buyers, volume pricing, multi-unit discounts, and nationwide LTL freight shipping.
- [About Us](https://www.buypalletjacks.com/about): Our complete refurbishment process, load testing, rebuild standards, and 2-month warranty terms.
- [Contact](https://www.buypalletjacks.com/contact): Direct call/SMS contact, customer inquiry form, and dispatch assistance.

## Key Offerings & Equipment

- **Crown Pallet Jacks (Refurbished)**: Premium industrial manual pallet jacks (Crown PTH series), 5,000 lb capacity. Rebuilt with fresh hydraulic seals, inspected fork structure, and new rollers.
- **Altra Pallet Jacks (Refurbished)**: Heavy-duty commercial manual pallet jacks, 5,500 lb capacity. Rebuilt hydraulic pump, greased pivot points, and fully load-tested.
- **Pricing**: Typically 40%–60% off new OEM retail prices. Single units and discounted multi-unit bundles.
- **2-Month Warranty**: Covers hydraulic seal failures, pump leaks, structural frame defects, and roller binding.
- **Pickup Workflow**: Call or text (262) 254-1835, receive instant inventory confirmation and gate/unit access code, pick up same-day at the nearest secure facility.

## Contact Information

- **Phone & SMS**: (262) 254-1835 (E.164: +12622541835)
- **Primary Website**: https://www.buypalletjacks.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Friday 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Sunday by appointment.
